value.rationale: Fixed-edge robustness of Euclidean edge-gradient reconstruction is a natural stability design criterion. Connected simple rank-two graphs are precisely the first networks with interacting or disjoint cyclic inconsistencies. The complete classification isolates a unique worst topology (with a six-edge exception), an exact ten-edge amplification threshold and sharp limiting amplification three, furnishing structural bounds not merely an isolated calculation.
